cohort: The study participants were newborns from whom serum samples were collected.
finding: Levels of GSH, LOOH, and Hsp60 in newborn sera are complexly interrelated and associated with gestational age and delivery modality, with specific inverse and positive correlations varying by mode of birth.
mod_finding: Spontaneous vaginal delivery was independently associated with increased GSH levels and led to inverse correlations between Hsp60 and GSH, whereas cesarean delivery showed positive correlations between Hsp60 and GSH.
